H5912.name: Achan
H5912.brief: An Israelite who stole devoted things, causing Israel's defeat.
H5912.short: Achan took devoted things, leading to Israel's defeat at Ai.

H5907H.name: Achbor
H5907H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5907H.brief: Official during the reign of King Josiah
H5907H.short: Achbor, also known as Abdon, was an official during the reign of King Josiah of Judah and was involved in the discovery of the Book of the Law and the subsequent religious reforms.

H5907G.name: Achbor
H5907G.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5907G.short: Achbor was an Edomite king, the son of Baal-hanan, who reigned before the establishment of the Israelite monarchy.

H5915H.name: Achsah
H5915H.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5915H.brief: Daughter of Caleb, the son of Hur
H5915H.short: Achsah is mentioned as the daughter of Caleb, the son of Hur, in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

H5915G.name: Achsah
H5915G.brief: Daughter of Caleb; wife of Othniel
H5915G.short: Achsah was the daughter of Caleb, given in marriage to Othniel as a reward for capturing Kiriath-sepher, and she requested springs of water from her father as a blessing.

H5964H.name: Alemeth
H5964H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5964H.short: Alemeth was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin.

H5964I.name: Alemeth
H5964I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5964I.brief: Son of Jehoaddah, a Benjamite from Gibeon
H5964I.short: Alemeth was a son of Jehoaddah (or 'Jehoadah'), a Benjamite from Gibeon, and is listed in the genealogies of Saul's family.

H5933.name: Alvah
H5933.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5933.short: Alvah was an Edomite chief, a descendant of Esau through his son Eliphaz.

H5935.name: Alvan
H5935.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5935.short: Alvan was a Horite chief, a descendant of Seir, who lived in the land of Edom before Esau's descendants.

H5988I.name: Ammiel
H5988I.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H5988I.short: Ammiel was a Levite gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

H5988H.name: Ammiel
H5988H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5988H.short: Ammiel was the father of Machir, who provided assistance to David during his flight from Absalom.

H5988G.name: Ammiel
H5988G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5988G.brief: Spy from the tribe of Dan
H5988G.short: Ammiel, the son of Gemalli, was the representative from the tribe of Dan among the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

H5989K.name: Ammihud
H5989K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5989K.brief: Descendant of Judah living in Jerusalem
H5989K.short: Ammihud, a descendant of Judah, was among those who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

H5989J.name: Ammihud
H5989J.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5989J.brief: Father of Talmai, king of Geshur
H5989J.short: Ammihud (or Ammihur) was the father of Talmai, the king of Geshur, to whom Absalom fled after killing his brother Amnon.

H5989G.name: Ammihud
H5989G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5989G.brief: Father of Elishama, leader of Ephraim
H5989G.short: Ammihud was the father of Elishama, the leader of the tribe of Ephraim during the wilderness journey.

H5989H.name: Ammihud
H5989H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5989H.brief: Father of Shemuel, leader from Simeon
H5989H.short: Ammihud was the father of Shemuel, the leader from the tribe of Simeon appointed to help divide the land of Canaan.

H5989I.name: Ammihud
H5989I.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5989I.brief: Father of Pedahel, leader from Naphtali
H5989I.short: Ammihud was the father of Pedahel, the leader from the tribe of Naphtali appointed to help divide the land of Canaan.

H5992H.name: Amminadab
H5992H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5992H.brief: Levite leader during the Ark's transfer
H5992H.short: Amminadab was a Levite leader from the Uzzielite clan who participated in the transfer of the Ark of the Covenant to Jerusalem.

H5992G.name: Amminadab
H5992G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5992G.brief: Father-in-law of Aaron, ancestor of David
H5992G.short: Amminadab was the father of Elisheba, who married Aaron, and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

H5993.name: Amminadib
H5993.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5993.brief: Noble mentioned in a love song
H5993.short: Amminadib is mentioned in a poetic passage in the Song of Solomon, possibly referring to a noble or prince.

H5996.name: Ammishaddai
H5996.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5996.brief: Father of Ahiezer, leader of Dan
H5996.short: Ammishaddai was the father of Ahiezer, the leader of the tribe of Dan during the wilderness journey.

H5990.name: Ammizabad
H5990.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H5990.brief: Son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men
H5990.short: Ammizabad was the son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men, and served as his father's second-in-command.

H5987.name: Amok
H5987.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5987.brief: Priest who returned from Babylonian exile
H5987.short: Amok was a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and signed the covenant under Nehemiah.

H5986.name: Amos
H5986.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5986.brief: Prophet from Tekoa who prophesied to Israel
H5986.short: Amos, a shepherd from Tekoa, called by God as a prophet to Israel.

H5941.name: Eli
H5941.desc: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H5941.brief: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh
H5941.short: Eli was the high priest and judge of Israel who ministered at the tabernacle in Shiloh.

H5902.name: Iram
H5902.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5902.short: Iram was an Edomite chief, a descendant of Esau.

H5901.name: Iri
H5901.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5901.brief: Son of Bela, grandson of Benjamin.
H5901.short: Iri was a son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin.

H5900.name: Iru
H5900.brief: Son of Caleb, brother of Elah and Naam.
H5900.short: Iru was a son of Caleb, along with his brothers Elah and Naam.

H5918.name: Ochran
H5918.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5918.short: Ochran was the father of Pagiel, a leader from the tribe of Asher during the Exodus.

H5910.name: Acco
H5910.brief: A seaport in Asher, also called Ptolemais.
H5910.short: Acco, a port city in Asher, later known as Ptolemais.

H5911.name: Achor Valley
H5911.brief: A valley near Jericho, where Achan was stoned.
H5911.short: The Valley of Achor, where Achan was punished for his sin.

H5964G.name: Alemeth
H5964G.short: Alemeth, also known as Almon, was a Levitical city allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.

H5971J.name: Amaw
H5971J.brief: A place near the Euphrates River, associated with Balaam.
H5971J.short: Amaw, a place near the Euphrates, where Balaam son of Beor lived.

H5983.name: Ammon
H5983.brief: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.
H5983.short: Ammon, a nation descended from Lot, and its capital Rabbah, often in conflict with Israel.

H5963.name: Diblathaim
H5963.brief: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings.
H5963.short: Diblathaim, also known as Almon-diblathaim or Beth-diblathaim, was a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings.

H5904.name: Ir-nahash
H5904.brief: A town associated with the descendants of Eshton
H5904.short: Ir-nahash, a town associated with the descendants of Eshton (<ref="1Ch.4.12">1Ch.4.12</ref>).

H5971H.name: People's Gate
H5971H.brief: A gate in Jerusalem mentioned by Jeremiah
H5971H.short: The People's Gate was one of the gates of Jerusalem, where the prophet Jeremiah was instructed to proclaim God's message.

H5981.name: Ummah
H5981.brief: A town allotted to the tribe of Asher
H5981.short: Ummah, a town allotted to the tribe of Asher in the division of the Promised Land (<ref="Josh. 19:30">Josh. 19:30</ref>).

H5961.name: Alamoth
H5961.brief: A musical term, possibly referring to a high pitch
H5961.short: Alamoth is a musical term used in the superscriptions of some Psalms, possibly referring to a high pitch or a musical instrument .

H5906.name: Bear
H5906.brief: Constellation mentioned in God's discourse with Job
H5906.short: The Bear is a constellation referred to in God's speeches to Job, showcasing God's power and wisdom in creation.
